goalTitle: v42 Goal Supervisor Runtime Context Loop

tasks.title: Bootstrap v42 runbook, fixture, and managed goal
acceptance: Tracked v42 plan, runbook, and fixture exist on main and point to the released v42 baseline.
The tracked v42 entry uses release evidence, GitHub release evidence, and local supervisor MVP notes as historical source material.
The fixture validates as goal-runbook.v1 and keeps the scoped release gate set limited to pnpm-check, pnpm-test, workbench-build, diff-check, and docs-updated.
Managed-goal replay is possible from the fixture, but v43 planning must use tracked repository files instead of untracked .symphony state as its primary entry point.
State changes remain event-backed and controlled.
copyOnlyCommands: node --input-type=module -e "import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { assertGoalRunbookContract } from './src/symphony/goal-runbook-contracts.js'; const path='fixtures/contracts/goal-runbook.v42-goal-supervisor-runtime-context-loop.v1.json'; const runbook=JSON.parse(await readFile(path,'utf8')); assertGoalRunbookContract(runbook); console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok:true, path, goalId:runbook.goalId, tasks:runbook.tasks.length, releaseGates:runbook.releaseGates }));"

tasks.title: State store and route engine contracts
acceptance: Supervisor state records goal id, repo, active lease, requests, threads, results, checkpoints, blockers, operator notifications, context policy, model route, and updated-at metadata.
Route decisions use event sequence plus validated local results instead of only summarized ledger state.
Release closeout stays blocked until explicit operator authorization exists.
State writes follow a single-writer, atomic update model.
State changes remain event-backed and controlled.

tasks.title: App thread adapter and result protocol
acceptance: A created thread is not considered active until the App adapter can read it back.
Thread binding rejects duplicate bindings and unreadable thread ids.
Result parsing is append-only and idempotent.
Missing or malformed result blocks trigger one bounded correction path before recovery escalation.
App notLoaded remains a non-mutating wait state.

tasks.title: Workspace manager and evidence-location gates
acceptance: Workspace preparation records source task, source worktree, target worktree, copied files, deleted files, dependency setup, and base commit.
Worktrees are checked for dependency readiness before dispatch.
Root status is checked before and after each child phase.
Role results are rejected when evidence exists only in the root checkout or outside the assigned worktree.
Verification inventory includes tracked, staged, deleted, and untracked files.

tasks.title: Daemon, heartbeat, operator notification, and progress monitor
acceptance: Daemon health is separated from manual tick freshness.
Heartbeat does not start duplicate work while an active lease exists.
Approval-required and blocked states include exact goal, task, role, phase, reason, and safe resume command.
A stale daemon with an active child yields a clear operator-visible poll or restart notification.
Progress projection reports active child age, latest tick, and retry or timeout policy.

tasks.title: Workbench and CLI projection
acceptance: CLI projection returns bounded JSON for supervisor status and next action.
Workbench projection displays active lease, thread id, task, role, phase, latest checkpoint, blockers, operator notifications, and safe resume command.
Projection does not run shell commands, create threads, register events, open local files, merge, push, tag, publish, or call providers.
Write actions remain controlled by existing goal event commands and explicit preview or confirm paths.
Release closeout stays visible as approval-required until explicit operator authorization exists.
